mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing storage in a small home involves creative solutions that utilize every available area. Consider built-in shelving, vertical storage units, and furniture with hidden compartments, such as ottomans with storage or beds with drawers underneath. Wall-mounted shelves and pegboards can free up floor space. Think about multi-purpose items, like a bench that doubles as shoe storage. Custom cabinetry designed to fit awkward nooks and crannies can also significantly increase your storage capacity without making the space feel cluttered. Efficient organization systems for closets and drawers are also key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize storage with built-in shelving, multi-functional furniture, and vertical storage solutions. Utilize wall space and custom cabinetry to make the most of every corner.
